entries.positive_observation: The current raw restores both dark brows and a distinct compact right-edge note tab. The yellow mascot retains green-ringed black eyes, one stern closed mouth, the viewer-left pose, dark gray-green peaked cap with two silver insignia groups, field-gray tunic and two pale collar tabs. entries.alpha_decision: Native RGBA and white/cyan inspection show exterior transparency with no visible interior holes or working-matte halo; internal 252-254 values are not rejection grounds. The remaining visible note-group RGB defect prevents production approval and is not a reason to substitute alpha mechanically.
entries.visible_limitations: Tiny cap/collar insignia and note glyph identities are unreadable at 65x67. The rejection is based on the clear replacement of separated irregular groups by two long bars, not guessed writing or tiny embroidery.
